behavior.closedJobFirst: The complete closed job (subject, language, limits, allowed output types, code and input bytes) is validated before any artifact is registered, so a bad limit, output type or subject cannot leave orphan artifacts.
behavior.abortPrecedence: An already-aborted signal rejects with SANDBOX_BROKER_CLIENT_ABORTED before the nonce generator or clock is consumed and before any upload.
behavior.envelopeReservation: Exactly one nonce and one signing instant are reserved and validated after the abort check and before the first artifact upload. A throwing generator, a non-string or schema-invalid nonce, and a negative, unsafe or lifetime-overflowing clock are rejected as SANDBOX_PRODUCER_CONFIGURATION_INVALID with zero artifact registrations and zero submissions.
behavior.singleEnvelope: The reserved nonce and issuedAt are reused for the one signed OA_ANALYSIS_JOB_V1 envelope, so every uploaded artifact and the submission share the same pre-validated signing clock. The producer still submits once and never retries an ambiguous submission.
